item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo announces marriage to Georgina Rodriguez in Portugal
item.description: Football's most famous current player wed his long-term partner Georgina Rodriguez after a decade together.

item.title: At least 15 dead, dozens missing as ferry capsizes in Zimbabwe
item.description: Zimbabwe’s Civil Protection Unit says the ferry was carrying more than its capacity of 90 people when it capsized.

item.title: Why have several nations raised red flags over Indian farm exports?
item.description: As Tokyo turns back mangoes, Beijing blocks rice, and European inspectors flag spices, Indian growers ask what's wrong.

item.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine has sent proposals to US to end war with Russia
item.description: Ukraine's president also says Russia will use its election next month as a pretext to declare a new mobilisation.

item.title: Can Trump keep his ‘irritation’ with Netanyahu in check?
item.description: Israel’s PM Benjamin Netanyahu has rejected Donald Trump’s Gaza peace plan which has exposed tensions between the two.

item.title: Israeli raids, arrests continue as UN warns West Bank at ‘breaking point’
item.description: Israeli forces arrest 23 Palestinians and demolish home of man killed in confrontation with Israeli settlers in July.

item.title: Did Trump flee an Iranian assassination plot on a catering truck?
item.description: New reports reveal the US President hid in a catering truck to switch planes over an alleged bomb plot in July.

item.title: Trump says secret plane switch ‘up to the Secret Service’
item.description: US President Donald Trump says the decision to make a plane switch in Turkiye after the NATO summit.

item.title: Drone strikes power station near Libya’s largest oil refinery
item.description: A drone has struck a power station in Libya’s western city of Zawiya

item.title: Russia frees ex-US marine Gilman jailed since 2022
item.description: Russia has released former US marine Robert Gilman, who had been jailed since 2022 for attacking a police officer.

item.title: Oil prices rise as attacks dent hopes for Strait of Hormuz reopening
item.description: Brent crude climbs as renewed violence dampens hopes for a return to stability in energy markets.

item.title: Six killed in Houthi attack on Bab al-Mandeb ship, Yemen’s government says
item.description: Deaths on Egyptian-owned Tihamah mark first shipping deaths linked to Houthis since the US-Israel war on Iran began.

item.title: Dozens dead and missing after ferry capsizes in Zimbabwe
item.description: An overloaded ferry capsized on Zimbabwe’s Lake Kariba, killing at least 15 people and leaving 27 missing.

item.title: Iran holds firm on Hormuz conditions as Pakistan’s Naqvi visits Tehran
item.description: Iran's top security official says the Strait of Hormuz will not reopen unless the US meets its conditions.

item.title: Stronghold of Syrian revolution celebrates Assad’s death sentence
item.description: Syrians in Idlib gathered in celebration after a court sentenced ousted President Bashar al-Assad

item.title: On the ground in Cali, Colombia’s worst-hit city after the quake
item.description: Reporting from the rubble of an apartment building, Al Jazeera’s Latin America Editor Lucia Newman describes the scene.

item.title: Zambia to vote as economic hardship tests government reforms
item.description: Debt restructuring, inflation and copper revenues are emerging as key issues in the vote.

item.title: N Korea launches ballistic missile as S Korea, US plan military drills
item.description: Pyongyang conducts second weapons test in less than a week as Seoul, Washington gear up for annual military exercises.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump claims US in ‘total control’ of Strait of Hormuz
item.description: US forces disable a Panama-flagged cargo ship attempting to sail towards an Iranian port.

item.title: Cargo ship in flames after Houthi attack in Bab al-Mandeb strait
item.description: Footage shows an Egyptian-owned cargo vessel in flames in the Bab al-Mandeb strait after a suspected Houthi attack.

item.title: Colombia scrambles to find survivors after deadly earthquake
item.description: At least 254 deaths have been reported so far, as rescue workers continue to sift through collapsed buildings.

item.title: Father and sons forced to manually clear rubble in Gaza
item.description: Forced to rely on basic tools, a father and his sons are clearing the rubble of their destroyed home in Gaza.

item.title: Relatives mourn victims of Pakistan avalanche
item.description: Relatives gathered to mourn the three Nepali mountaineers, Kili Pemba Sherpa, Gyalu Sherpa, and Nima Sherpa.

item.title: Pakistan interior minister in Tehran amid talks to reopen Hormuz
item.description: Pakistan’s interior minister Mohsin Naqvi has held talks with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in Tehran.

item.title: In Gaza’s tents, widows face war’s harshest realities alone
item.description: Widows in Gaza struggle alone under displacement, burdened by loss, insecurity, and daily battles for survival.
